text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaaah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's face twists in distress as she's surrounded by lambs.
As for how things turned out like this――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was heading back from an errand
with Admire Vega, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Curren-san sent me more animal videos...
I was just watching them with a sigh."

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text: "‘Next stop, Bokujo-mae Station. Bokujo-mae Station~’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She claimed she was exasperated, but looking at her phone,
her profile was undeniably bright and cheerful.
A ranch... might be just the right change of pace.
choice_data_list: Do you want to go see some animals?
Do you want to go see some animals?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "At the ranch, they happened to be holding a lamb petting event—and that brings us to the present."

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaaah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a minute...
Why are you coming toward me...?!
choice_data_list: Maybe she wants to be petted?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wait, why to me—

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaaah. Baaaah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: E-Even if you rub your head against me like that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
...Just for a little bit, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Ah... It's so warm...)

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaaah. Baaaah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wh-What... you too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(? ...Running my fingers through this feels different from the last one...
And somehow—...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...This girl has very little body fat.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's a lack of nutrition or stress...
Either way, this little one's fluffiness has lost its bounce..."
choice_data_list: I'll go ask someone at the farm!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, when I passed along what Admire Vega had said to the ranch staff—

text_block_list.name: Ranch Employee
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. She's a newcomer, so
maybe she's lacking sleep from all the stress...

text_block_list.name: Ranch Employee
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for letting me know!
I'm so glad we found it quickly!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's just a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not like I did anything special—
choice_data_list: At least it helped the little lamb.
At least it was for the little lamb's sake.
I wonder if this could be applied to other things too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not like I did anything special—
choice_data_list: At least it helped the little lamb.
At least it was for the little lamb's sake.
I wonder if this could be applied to other things too?

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: Baaaah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad about that, but...

text_block_list.name: Lambs
text_block_list.text: "Baaah! Baaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (That little guy's been chirping toward me this whole time.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Are you thanking me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Heh... No way...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That couldn't possibly be true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, in the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Fluff!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. Are you alright?!
I tripped for a second there...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (The feel of Hayahide-san's hair just now...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Hayahide-san.
Are you getting proper sleep?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
! W-Well, the thing is...
I had a lot of trouble falling asleep last night...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, does it really show on my face that much...?
Thank you for the advice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Less like a face, and more like...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No... it's nothing.
Please take care of yourself...
